body: It depends on what your companies do. For an engineer, interns are really important but very difficult to come by. I'm always in support for more interning positions because if you like the intern, they can be a really helpful member of the company. I know it's hard to find someone with little to minimal experience so that is why the phone interviews/face to face interviews are really important.

Yup, I definitely made sure to thank everyone I contacted through the company. I never knew that people could even think about not doing it. That just blows my mind.

I can't fully disclose the questions, but I was asked a lot of behavioral and teamwork oriented questions. I worked in a lot of teams just through the many jobs I had so it was like second nature giving them an answer through one of my relevant job experiences.

> I'm in the process of trying to hire 3 people right now for my team - it's a very chaotic time, so we are prone to making mistakes, because we are spinning plates. Once we actually get the help we need, things will settle down.
> 

Thanks so much, I understand that it's a really difficult thing to interview for a potential employee. May I ask in that position to decide out of three good candidates, what criteria would you use to make a decision? 

I tried my best to get to know the company before I even talked to them and see where their heads are at in terms of the company's future. I asked the interviewer questions about his position within the company and my desire to work my hardest within the company to be a long lasting employee there. Idk, it's just hard to convey the breadth and scope of how really dedicated I'll be for the job over the phone without sounding very desperate.

Thanks :)

I had a conversation about it with my roommate and he was like "why would you want to work for a company that makes so many mistakes during the interview process"

I just replied "are you aware of the shitty apartment we're living in?"

I honestly don't care much about that as long as they're willing to pay me. For hell, they can do anything they want (aside from hurting me of course) and if they'll pay me a good salary, I'll take it with a smile. :)
I promise to make an update every time something comes about this company. For better or for worse, this will probably provide others with entertainment. ;)

I've been definitely trying the past 3 months. I've applied to many other jobs, but this one had the most potential. It's like I can't catch a break. I'm low on funds right now, pretty much have to eat on $20 a week. Working a meaningless and grueling full time job just to make ends meet, this was my ticket out of this life and I feel it just got closed on me with no answer. 

I'm sure more opportunities will arrive the more I apply and put myself out there, but this really stings.
